title: Catholic churches and bands, church music in Reserve
summary: Catholic churches did not have bands for funerals; the Reserve church had a piano; Baptists and clubs used bands.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: I was going to ask, speaking of that Methodist Church, did the Catholic Church ever have any of the bands for the Catholic funerals in the old days?
No, no, no, no, no, no band for, I don't remember, I don't remember that.
Just Methodist and Baptist? Yeah, just Baptist.
I never, Catholic don't never hardly have bands for nobody.
They don't now, I wondered in the old days.
